draft.text: You came in because your elbows have been hurting more, especially when you sit a lot at work.
You have pain, swelling, and stiffness in your elbows, especially in the morning or after sitting for a long time.
You have chronic osteoarthritis in your elbows, which is causing the pain and stiffness.
An X-ray of your elbows will be ordered to check the condition.
You will keep taking meloxicam as prescribed.
Your doctor will review your medication and may refer you for more treatment if needed.
